### God of War — Revenge, Fatherhood & Redemption

God of War follows Kratos, a former Greek god of war who has left his violent past behind and settled in the harsh world of Norse mythology. After the death of his wife, Faye, Kratos begins a journey with his young son, Atreus, to fulfill her final wish: scattering her ashes from the highest peak in the realms.

As they travel through dangerous lands filled with powerful monsters, ancient gods, and mythical creatures, Kratos struggles to teach Atreus how to survive. However, his greatest challenge isn't defeating their enemies—it's learning how to be a father while keeping the rage and secrets of his past under control.

Their journey becomes increasingly dangerous as they encounter powerful figures from Norse mythology. Atreus begins discovering the truth about his identity, while Kratos realizes that hiding his past may not be enough to protect his son from the future waiting for him.

The story explores themes of fatherhood, grief, sacrifice, destiny, and redemption. It shows how Kratos must confront the person he once was while trying to raise his son to become someone better.

What makes God of War compelling is the relationship between Kratos and Atreus, as a warrior known for his brutality learns that protecting his son requires more than strength—it requires patience, trust, and understanding.

💬 He was once a god who destroyed everything in his path. Now, he must learn how to protect the one thing that matters most.
